template: normalize( group_normalize( if_else( greater( right_tail( ts_zscore( ts_mean( {stoxx_europe_600_ucits_weight}, 21 ) / ts_median( {stoxx_europe_600_ucits_weight}, 126 ), 252 ), 1.5 ), ts_decay_linear( ts_mean( {stoxx_europe_600_ucits_weight}, 21 ) / ts_median( {stoxx_europe_600_ucits_weight}, 126 ), 10 ), if_else( less( left_tail( ts_zscore( ts_mean( {stoxx_europe_600_ucits_weight}, 21 ) / ts_median( {stoxx_europe_600_ucits_weight}, 126 ), 252 ), -1.5 ), ts_decay_linear( ts_mean( {stoxx_europe_600_ucits_weight}, 21 ) / ts_median( {stoxx_europe_600_ucits_weight}, 126 ), 10 ), 0 ) ), group_cartesian_product( industry, subindustry ) ) )
idea: 双尾截断与细粒度分组版。使用right_tail/left_tail基于252日Zscore直接截断±1.5σ之外的极端值，将中间温和偏离视为无效数据(NaN)；对保留的极端信号应用ts_decay_linear(10日)线性衰减加权，强调近期配置变化的持续性；采用group_cartesian_product(industry,subindustry)实现二级行业-子行业交叉分组中性化，控制更细粒度的风格暴露，最后normalize确保全书多空净敞口平衡。
